page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr6.20xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 80 dedicated vCPUs mapped directly to 80 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 3.1 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. With a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, each vCPU has exclusive access to a physical core, eliminating resource contention from hyperthreading.

The instance is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 9.6 GB per core. It does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps. There are no onboard GPUs, making this instance unsuitable for hardware-accelerated graphics or deep learning workloads.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the high memory density relative to the CPU allocation makes this instance suitable for workloads requiring large memory footprints without the overhead of hyperthreaded virtual cores. The dedicated physical core allocation ensures predictable compute performance. This hardware profile is designed for memory-intensive workloads such as large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, and heavy data processing pipelines.
